layout: each file is one horizontal strip of frames, left to right, all the same size

blend.add: additive (glows, light): src.rgb * src.a added to the scene
blend.normal: ordinary alpha blending (smoke, dust, solid objects, dark magic)

layer.over: drawn above units (sort with the target, just in front of it)
layer.ground: drawn on the floor under units, like a decal

loop: loop: true repeats frames loopStart..end (loopStart defaults to 0); false plays once and is removed

attach.feet: anchor goes on the target's ground point (the character's own anchor, 16,37 in its frame)
attach.body: anchor goes on the target's chest: 15 px above its ground point
attach.overhead: anchor goes just above the target's head: 36 px above its ground point
attach.projectile: anchor moves along the flight path; the art faces +x (right), rotate it to the direction

scale: drawn at the characters' pixel scale: show at the same multiple as the sprites

slash.name: Slash
slash.note: sword, axe and mace swings; mirror for a left-facing attacker

thrust.name: Thrust
thrust.note: spear, dagger and rapier stabs; points right, mirror or rotate to face the target

arrow.name: Arrow
arrow.note: points right; rotate to the flight direction

arrow_trail.name: Arrow in flight
arrow_trail.note: points right; rotate to the flight direction

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.note: points right; rotate to the flight direction

eldritch.name: Eldritch blast
eldritch.note: points right; rotate to the flight direction

pillar.name: Pillar of light
pillar.note: bless (holy, on an ally) or smite (on a foe)

misty.name: Misty step
misty.note: play at the start tile (unit hidden from frame 4), then reversed at the destination

circle.name: Magic circle
circle.note: casting circle under the caster, or a spell's area marker

flames.name: Engulfing flames
flames.note: fire damage on a unit: tongues climb the body; hellfire for warlock and fiend fire

frost.name: Frost burst
frost.note: cold damage: faceted crystals grow out of the target and shatter

shock.name: Shock
shock.note: lightning damage on a unit: forked arcs crackle round it

necrotic.name: Necrotic grasp
necrotic.note: necrotic damage: wisps coil in and a skull flares; blood for life drain

radiant.name: Radiant flare
radiant.note: radiant damage: rays burst and light sifts down

psychic.name: Psychic ripple
psychic.note: psychic damage: wobbling rings spread from the head

thunder.name: Thunderclap
thunder.note: thunder damage: concentric shockwaves over the ground, about a tile and a half across

acid.name: Acid splash
acid.note: acid damage: a splash on the chest that runs down and puddles

toxin.name: Poison spray
toxin.note: poison damage on one target; the spray arrives from the left, mirror to face

force.name: Force shatter
force.note: force damage: a honeycomb of force breaks into hexagon shards

restore.name: Restoration
restore.note: cleansing: a ring sinks head to foot (heals rise instead)

ward.name: Ward
ward.note: shield of faith, mage armor, barkskin: rune plates lock round the unit

bless.name: Blessing
bless.note: bless, aid: a halo over the head and motes sifting down

inspire.name: Inspiration
inspire.note: bardic inspiration, heroism, rally: notes burst and float up

rage.name: Rage
rage.note: rage, action surge, war cries: a hollow shell of flame

hold.name: Hold
hold.note: hold person or monster, command: rune rings close and lock

dispel.name: Dispel
dispel.note: dispel magic, counterspell: a sigil cracks and shatters

web.name: Web
web.note: web thrown over a tile; the hazards set's web holds it afterwards
